title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: It's Showtime at the Apollo
description:
S1 E105 — Episode 105
It's Showtime at the Apollo is a syndicated music television show, first broadcast on September 12, 1987. The show features live performances from both professional and up-and-coming artists, and also features the Amateur Night competition.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E15 — Bing Crosby, The Supremes, David Steinberg
Bing teaches golf; The Supremes help Freddie Johnson do holiday shopping; David does monologue and Geraldine's a bunny waitress.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E16 — Steve Lawrence, Zero Mostel
Mostel portrays a painter and a ledge-jumper; Flip defends his singing ability and Charley’s Diner serves Mostel and Lawrence.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E19 — Joe Namath, George Carlin, Abbey Lincoln, Johnny Mathis
Carlin does his Indian Sergeant routine; Abbey dates Freddie Johnson; Flip & Mathis compare dogs and Geraldine works at Namath’s gym.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E20 — Barbara Feldon, Art Carney, Hal Frazier
Cast parodies Mission Impossible; Flip chats with Hal; sketches incl. a gangster at the veterinarian and bowling night.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E22 — Ray Charles, Leslie Uggams, Don Rickles
Flip promotes his latest LP; Uggams rents Freddie Johnson a friend (Rickles) in NYC; Geraldine fawns over Ray Charles.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E26 — Tim Conway, Johnny Brown, Sandy Duncan
Flip & Tim play pool; Sandy sells books to Freddie Johnson; Brown does impressions and Conway is a school headmaster.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E1 — Lucille Ball, Ed Sullivan, Osmond Brothers
Lucy & Flips are two halves of a horse; the whole cast portrays Peanuts characters; Geraldine & Lucy are car hops at the drive-in.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E2 — Joan Rivers, George Gobel
Flip does the shell game; Joan does stand-up and plays a cabdriver; Freddie Johnson buys jewelry from Gobel & Rivers.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E9 — Unappreciated Interest
Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E10 — Thanksgiving
With Dee sick in bed with a bad cold, Moesha offers to prepare the Thanksgiving feast but finds herself engaged in a fierce cooking competition with Hakeem’s mother.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E11 — To Sleep, Perchance To Dream
Moesha starts having recurring romantic dreams about Hakeem, giving her second thoughts about their friendship and about sharing a room with him and Niecy on an upcoming ski trip.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E12 — He Doth Protest Too Much
Moesha discovers that some of her college classes are more difficult than she thought; she has a hard time in Chemistry and reluctantly agrees to let Niecy tutor her.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E13 — Let’s Talk About Sex
Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E11 — Two Men And A Baby
Eddie enlists Malcolm to help babysit for his infant cousin.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E12 — The Way We Weren't
An argument leads to Malcolm and Eddie recalling their years together.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E13 — It Almost Happened One Night
An old rival's visit causes Simone to pretend she and Malcolm are husband and wife.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E14 — Whose Room Is It Anyway
An argument over whose room is largest lands Malcolm in the hospital.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E15 — Tough Love
Fired from her job and dumped by her girlfriend, Malcolm's sister arrives to stay with him and Eddie.
